successors.name: Emirate of Afghanistan
successors.text: Badakhshan with its dependent district Wakhan, 'fully belonging to the Amir of Kabul' (1873)

ledger.x: 1657: an uprising against the Uzbeks establishes the Emirate of Badakhshan under the Yarid dynasty, first Mir Yar Beg Sahibzada.
1873: the Anglo-Russian agreement recognises Badakhshan with its dependent district Wakhan as belonging to the Amir of Kabul.
1873: Badakhshan absorbed into Afghan Turkestan; the page does not state the dynasty's end explicitly, 1873 is the annexation date.

certainty.note: Page gives no dated extents; modern province as stand-in.
